network.name: Arc Testnet
network.note: TESTNET. No real money. Arc mainnet opens 2026-09-16.

addresses.quoteTokenNote: NVDAx — clearly-labeled testnet stand-in for NVDA (MockStock, 18 decimals). Replaced by a real tokenized stock on a real-stock deployment.

previous.note: v1 (2026-09-09). Its on-chain description said fees 'lock' $WALL for 5 years and that buybacks happen on every trade; both are wrong (5-year linear vest; buyback runs when the platform sweeps fees). LauncherToken has no description setter, so v2 was launched with corrected text. v1 still exists on-chain and on Radian's Explore; it is not the product.

launchParams.creatorFeeRecipientNote: placeholder — Phase 2 points this at WallTreasury

verification: Platform contracts are a source-identical port of Pons V2 (upstream Sourcify-verified on Robinhood Chain; on Arc testnet only the factory is verified on Arcscan so far). Verification proves source = bytecode; it is not an audit.

phase1Mechanics.buybackShareOfFee: 35% (fee minus the 30% protocol share, times the 50% buyback split)
phase1Mechanics.buybackTrigger: sweepFees() by the platform fee-sweep operator or the curve deployer — not automatic per trade
phase1Mechanics.vault: PonsV2BuybackVault: 5-year LINEAR VEST released 70% to the creator / 30% to the protocol — a vest, not a burn or permanent lock
phase1Mechanics.onChainDescription: v2's on-chain description matches these mechanics word for word (vest, operator sweep, Phase 2 not live). v1's did not; see `previous`.
